assessments.reasoning: The five contiguous parts of SPDX’s json/details/CC-BY-3.0.json cover 74,805 bytes, SHA-256 5d777547db78211b1b918378ca526bb5010c377c7b678b912d7e64b7d0224ed2. The name is “Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported,” licenseId is CC-BY-3.0, licenseText is headed “Attribution 3.0 Unported,” and isDeprecatedLicenseId is false. Both citation fields give https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/legalcode.

The GitHub API for spdx/license-list-data identifies annotated tag object 76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b as v3.29.0. Its target type is commit and its target SHA is 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48, exactly the detail URL revision. The API reports the tag is unsigned.

As context, the Creative Commons capture at the cited URL has SHA-256 aa7cbb71214fb5709a70e710fbeefd8d9108a380699d393038b9ba11126f3a15 and the inline title “Attribution 3.0 Unported.” This identifies the object of SPDX’s citation. SPDX owns the list assertion.

challenge.method: Compared the exact release target, identifier, text heading and URL with the BY 4.0 link and with the other two 3.0 details. Examined §5 and the crossRef match field for evidence against text identity.
challenge.results: Only the BY record cites the unported /by/3.0/legalcode capture. SPDX’s §5 omits the publisher’s phrase “AND TO THE FULLEST EXTENT PERMITTED BY APPLICABLE LAW.” The crossRef match field contains the string “false.” Both observations are consistent with the limited assertion that SPDX cites the page.

limitations: The finding applies to this generated detail at this release. Its text, template and HTML are representations within one record and supply no independent corroboration.
The publisher digest measures live HTML at acquisition. Equality with the declared /legalcode.en canonical response is unverified.

The cross-reference determines neither semantic equivalence nor rights concerning a translation, adaptation, downstream work, project file or redistribution. SPDX deprecation concerns the identifier in this release. Index maintenance and publisher currency have separate evidence.
reasoning: The SPDX 3.29.0 generated detail record lists CC-BY-3.0. Both crossRef[0].url and seeAlso[0] give the exact publisher acquisition URL. The release tag targets the commit from which the detail was read. These fields establish the documentary correspondence despite differences in the displayed names and text.
